description: Deterministic strategy-state computation for one symbol: the current state of five published rule sets (ma_crossover, rsi_mean_reversion, momentum, leveraged_momentum, macd_crossover) plus an ensemble state over daily bars; BTC/ETH/SOL also carry a Coinversa sentiment block. Computed data, not a recommendation. Paid via x402 ($0.02 USDC on Base) when a payer wallet is configured; otherwise returns the payment requirements.

strategy.description: Return only this one strategy's state

symbol.description: Symbol, e.g. SPY, AAPL, BTC, ETH, SOL (16 equities/ETFs + BTC/ETH/SOL in the core universe)

name: trading_signal
